title: 第十一章 遗憾第十二章 罗兰秘闻
slug: 开局a级禁物玩家给我打工
content_zh:
;;
林奇看着眼前的箱子有些犹豫。
这是舅舅的东西？为什么要放在妈妈的房间里？
还是说这是妈妈的遗物？那舅舅为什么从来没有跟我说过？
说实话，乱开别人的房间已经很没有素质了，难道还要乱开别人的东西吗？
就在林奇犹豫之时耳边突然传来一阵犹如天籁的声音。
“怎么不打开看看？”伊莱娜问道。
ok，兄弟们，甩到锅了。
要是骂没素质就去骂伊莱娜，和我林某人可没关系哦。
林奇打开了箱子映入眼帘的是件折叠好的定制西装和一些小物件，上面还放了一封没拆开的信。
林奇本来以为这是舅舅的东西，正想关上的时候耳边突然传来系统的声音。
叮叮叮叮叮，十数声系统的声音从林奇耳畔响起。
什么意思？这一箱子全是禁物？？？
罗兰不会是什么走私家族吧。
怀揣着忐忑的心情林奇拿起了最上方的信件。
名称：【妈妈的信】
类型：【信件】
级别：【d级禁物】
能力：【可抵挡致命一击。】（伊萨里斯专属）
代价：妈妈的爱不需要代价。

介绍：罗兰家族长女萨沙·罗兰留给儿子伊萨里斯·罗兰的一封信。
林奇呆愣住了，一件复活甲的等级居然只有d？
不对，是因为这件禁物只有他能用才导致禁物等级过低。
林奇只感觉有一种强烈的意愿指示他打开这封信。
【伊萨里斯，当你看到这封信的时候我可能已经死了，但请相信妈妈永远爱你。
可惜没能亲眼看到你长大后的样子，不过没关系，妈妈为你准备了生日礼物。
八岁，这个时候的你还处于最讨人厌的阶段，尽管你十分懂事但孩子活泼好动的天性还是会驱使你，所以妈妈送你一个溜溜球，这是最近贵族圈里最受欢迎的玩具，妈妈希望你能喜欢。
九岁，你已经是大孩子了，如果你在妈妈的身边大概这时候正在学习罗兰家族的历史吧，所以妈妈送你一支钢笔，希望你可以写一些自己喜欢的东西。
十岁，一转眼你已经出生十年了，想想你刚出生的样子妈妈就想笑，丑丑的还没有头发，不过妈妈的儿子肯定是全天下最帅的，所以妈妈送你一个妈妈最喜欢的戒指，以后遇到喜欢的女孩就送给她哦~
十一岁，妈妈还真不知道大孩子喜欢什么东西，所以就送你一个妈妈喜欢的耳环吧。
十二岁，这个时候的你应该也交到几个朋友了吧，那妈妈就送你一些零花钱吧，不要小看这个卡哦，里面有很多很多很多钱的。
十三岁，送你一个帅气的墨镜。
content_en:
;;
Lin Qi looked at the box in front of him with some hesitation.
Is this my uncle's thing? Why put it in mom's room?
Or is this a relic from my mother? Then why did my uncle never tell me?
To be honest, it is already very disrespectful to open other people's rooms. Should I still open other people's things?
Just when Lin Qi was hesitating, a sound like the sound of nature suddenly came to his ears.
"Why don't you open it and take a look?" Elena asked.
OK, brothers, it’s the blame.
If you scold Elena for being unqualified, it has nothing to do with me, Lin.
Lynch opened the box and saw a folded custom-made suit and some small items, with an unopened letter on top.
Lin Qi originally thought it belonged to his uncle, but when he was about to close it, he suddenly heard the sound of the system in his ears.
Ding ding ding ding ding, dozens of systematic sounds sounded from Lin Qi's ears.
What's the meaning? Is this box full of forbidden items? ? ?
Roland can't be a smuggling family.
Lin Qi picked up the top letter with anxiety.
Name: [Mother’s Letter]
Type: [Letter]
Level: [Level D forbidden object]
Ability: [Can withstand a fatal blow. 】(Exclusive to Isaris)
Price: There is no price for mother’s love.
Introduction: A letter left by Sasha Roland, the eldest daughter of the Roland family, to her son Isaris Roland.
Lin Qi was stunned. The level of a piece of resurrection armor was actually only D?
No, it's because only he can use this forbidden object, which causes the forbidden object's level to be too low.
Lynch felt only a strong will directing him to open the letter.
[Isaris, I may be dead when you read this letter, but please believe that mother will always love you.
It's a pity that I didn't get to see you grow up, but it doesn't matter, my mother prepared a birthday gift for you.
At eight years old, you are still in the most annoying stage at this time. Although you are very sensible, the child's lively and active nature will still drive you, so your mother gives you a yo-yo, which is the most popular toy in the aristocratic circle recently. Mom hopes you like it.
At nine years old, you are already a big child. If you were with your mother, you would probably be studying the history of the Roland family at this time, so your mother gave you a pen in the hope that you could write something you like.
Ten years old. In the blink of an eye, you have been born for ten years. Mom wants to laugh when she thinks about your appearance when you were just born. You were so ugly that you had no hair. But your son must be the most handsome in the world, so your mother will give you a ring that she likes best. You can give it to the girl you like in the future~
At eleven years old, mom really doesn’t know what older children like, so I’ll give you an earring that mom likes.
At the age of twelve, you should have made a few friends by this time. Then mom will give you some pocket money. Don’t underestimate this card. There is a lot of money in it.
When you are thirteen, I will give you handsome sunglasses.
